view_issues: Figure age-adjusted rates (2.1–5.6 per 100,000) are hard to reconcile with 8.8 per 1,000 person-years. Table 2 deceased 6–12 CI (23.4–31.9) excludes its point estimate 22.6. Cochran-Armitage applied to rates is unusual. Tests behind Table 2 comparisons are unnamed.
